conditions.condition_text: Mark the high and low of the first 15 minutes of the New York open to define the Opening Range Breakout (ORB).
Establishes the initial range for the breakout strategy.
Zoom out to the higher time frame (e.g., 1H, 4H) to check the trend, VWAP, and liquidity zones.
Context provides clarity and helps avoid trading blind.
Wait for a candle to actually close and confirm the breakout outside the 15-minute range.
Confirmation helps avoid fakeouts and provides a clear risk-to-reward.
If the higher time frame is trending up, only look for long breakouts of the ORB; align with the trend.
Alignments with the trend massively increase the edge of the strategy.
Check the higher time frame for VWAP alignment and overall market context.
Overlay volume profile to identify liquidity zones and avoid fakeouts into supply or demand.
The higher time frame trend must align with the intended entry direction.
The speaker uses a stop loss above the previous five minute high in examples.
The speaker targets the regular trading hours gap fill.
